power.jaymospowers.cryo.desc: The cold answers you: skate on ice you freeze as you go, breathe frost, throw shards, shut things in ice and raise walls of it. Smoke it touches freezes into a killing fog.
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.starter: Faint Ice Slide: a lane of ice freezes under you and you skate on it, slower than you will; R again stops
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.starter.name: Faint Ice Slide
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.ability_1: Ice Slide (toggle): a lane of ice freezes under and ahead of you and you skate on it (W pushes off, Sprint harder, S brakes; you glide on and turn slowly at speed). Water freezes into a bridge that melts 10 s behind you. Costs hunger; walls hurt at speed
power.jaymospowers.cryo.swallowed: a skate forward on frost, chilling what you pass
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.ability_2: Frost Breath (hold): a cone of cold (8 blocks) for up to 5 s; what it catches is slowed and freezes, and long enough in it is frozen stiff. Water freezes over, fire on creatures goes out, smoke turns to freezing fog
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.ability_3: Ice Shards: a fan of five shards of ice that hit, slow and chill what they strike; smoke they fly through freezes
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.ability_4: Flash Freeze: whatever you look at (16 blocks) is shut in a shell of ice for 3 s, frozen through and held still
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.special: Ice Wall: a wall of packed ice (5 wide, 3 high) rises where you look (24 blocks); it melts after 15 s
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.special.name: Ice Wall
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.mode: Snow mode (toggle): Frost Breath and Ice Shards turn to snow; they slow and blind but never hurt (for friends and villagers)
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.mode.name: Snow mode
power.jaymospowers.cryo.key.ultimate: Blizzard: 20 s of whiteout round you (16 blocks): snow falls and lies, everything in it but you slowly freezes, smoke freezes to fog, and the white hides you
message.jaymospowers.cryo_hungry: Too hungry to keep the cold up.
message.jaymospowers.cryo_snow_on: Snow mode: your cold turns to harmless snow.
message.jaymospowers.cryo_snow_off: Snow mode off: your cold bites again.
message.jaymospowers.cryo_freeze_big: Too big to shut in ice.
message.jaymospowers.cryo_wall_nothing: Nowhere there to raise a wall.
